idea-plugin.name: Animoria
idea-plugin.description:
Animoria — Visual Asset Governance

Workspace-wide discovery, governance, and reference tracing for animated (Lottie, Rive, GIF, APNG, SVG) and static (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF) assets, directly inside your IDE sidebar.

Animoria acts as a local-first visual asset memory for developer teams who care about craft and codebase health. It automates the structural audit and reference tracing of visual assets in large repositories to prevent production bundle bloat and technical debt.

Key Features:

  • Asset Governance: Automatically scan and identify Unused (orphan), Duplicate (identical MD5 file hashes), or Overused animated assets exceeding customizable reference thresholds. Static-asset governance is on the roadmap.
  • Usage Traceability: Trace where assets are referenced across Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Dart, and more, jumping directly to the source file line.
  • Multi-Format Strategy: Seamlessly parses Lottie (.json), dotLottie (.lottie), Rive (.riv), GIF/APNG (.gif/.apng), Animated SVG (.svg), and indexes static SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF files alongside them.
  • Local & Offline-First: Secure, offline processing guarantees code and asset data never leave your local workspace.
